changes: First release in Modwerk for Digitakt I OS 1.53 and 1.54, on Core 2.1 with Machine Pages: STRING, a Karplus-Strong plucked string SRC machine.
Four exciters (BOW, HIT, NOISE, PLUCK) and STIFF, POS, SOFT, TONE and DECAY controls with their own ranges and defaults; values are saved, p-lockable and LFO destinations.
Works beside Note Accumulator and RAM Machines; through Machine Pages it cannot be combined with SOPHIE, Digi Neighbor, Digi Slicer, Digi Mono or Digi Poly.
Same code as the author's source at commit 69ab748; Modwerk only repackaged it.
